piezas.titulo: Reading words: Routine and immediate needs
texto: Reading and spelling of action and need verbs: «กิน» combines the mid-class consonant ก with the short upper vowel ิ and the nasal น (mid tone). «ดื่ม» has the mid-class consonant ด with the closed vowel ื, the mark ่ and the final ม (low tone). «นอน» is written with the low-class consonant น, the central vowel อ and the final น (mid tone). «ต้องการ» is a compound word made of «ต้อง» (must, falling tone) and «การ» (matter / action, mid tone). Recognising these verb roots makes it easier to read timetables and health notes quickly.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การตื่นเช้าและการออกกำลังกายเป็นประจำส่งผลดีต่อสุขภาพในระยะยาว» express?

opciones.texto: Getting up early and exercising regularly benefits your health in the long term.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การตื่นเช้าและการออกกำลังกายเป็นประจำส่งผลดีต่อสุขภาพในระยะยาว» from the text.

opciones.texto: Planning ahead avoids rushing during peak hours.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Eating at fixed times keeps the body's healthy rhythm.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ดื่ม» (to drink), what tone results from the mid-class consonant ด with the mark ่ (mái eek)?

opciones.texto: Low tone (เสียงเอก)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: a mid-class consonant with the sign ่ is always pronounced with a low tone.
Incorrect: it would need the sign ้.
Incorrect: in mid class, the high tone takes ๊.
